question: What was the literacy rate in India according to the 2011 Census?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**74.04**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **2011 Census**, the **literacy rate** in India was **74.04%**.
 
• The literacy rate was calculated for individuals aged **7 years and above**, based on their ability to read and write in any language.
 
• It showed a significant improvement from the 64.83
